name: 14211 · Buffalo, NY
findings: ZIP 14211 (Buffalo) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14211 (Buffalo) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14211 (Buffalo) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).
